project.name: MAX Grounding
project.purpose: Provide a self-hostable evidence-first grounding engine that retrieves, validates, compresses, and cites external evidence for LLMs and agents without giving the model authority to invent facts.
expected_outcomes: grounded responses backed by explicit evidence and citations
cross-platform core runtime with containerized service integrations

entry_points.name: Python package
entry_points.purpose: bootstrap runtime identity and package boundary

constraints: GitHub Actions is the acceptance authority.
Every completed phase is merged to main only after all required checks pass.
Core runtime must remain portable across Linux, Windows, and macOS.
Untrusted network content must never be treated as executable instructions.
No secrets may be committed to the repository.
